the mitochondrial genome of Myotis is not a good proxy for the nuclear genome and the nuclear genome is not a single entity.
The rapid diversification and high levels of gene flow among New World Myotid bats has led to a high degree of conflict between mitochondrial and nuclear phylogenies.
